CDCPersistentLog implements the CDCListener interface (via TemporalCDC::subscribeToChanges) and durably persists each ChangeEvent to a binary append-only Write-Ahead Log (WAL) on the file-system.

sect2.title: WAL segment format
sect2.para: Each segment is an append-only binary file named <segment_dir>/<prefix>_<segment_seq>.wal. A segment header is written once at creation time, followed by zero or more fixed-layout records:
A new segment is created automatically when the current segment reaches or exceeds max_segment_bytes (default 64 MiB).

sect2.title: CRC-32 validation
sect2.para: Each record carries a CRC-32/ISO-HDLC checksum of the JSON payload bytes. On open (open()), the log scans all records in the segment directory and discards any tail record whose CRC does not match — providing truncation recovery without data loss on abrupt shutdown.
